method: Static inspection of official Darwin arm64 and Linux x64 package/claude files. No downloaded executable was run.
stop_rows: 2.1.286_to_2.1.287: --output-format stream-json turn streaming for a context:fork skill invoked as the prompt
2.1.289_to_2.1.290: permission and safety checks after a PreToolUse hook rewrites tool input
why_this_surface: Research 374 stopped on the 2.1.287 forked stream and the 2.1.290 PreToolUse rewrite recheck; Research 422/423 adapted the 2.1.294 settings-hook surfaces. This file re-checks the 2.1.287 forked-stream surface on the 2.1.316-to-2.1.317 hop. The 2.1.290 rewrite surface is covered by the prompt/rewrite rows in selected-control-flow.json.
assistant_frame_description: An assistant message. While a response streams the CLI emits one assistant message per completed content block, so several consecutive assistant messages can share message.id and each carries just that block in message.content; on those, message.stop_reason is null and message.usage is not final \u2014 the turn's stop reason and total usage arrive on the result message. parent_tool_use_id is non-null when the message was produced inside a subagent started by that tool_use."
assistant_frame_description_byte_identit: The frozen claude-code-2.1.316 fixture proves 2.1.312..=2.1.316 identity; this run hashes the same description again on 2.1.316 and 2.1.317 and all four digests equal the frozen value.
assistant_frame_description_required_cla: emits one assistant message per completed content block
several consecutive assistant messages can share message.id
message.stop_reason is null and message.usage is not final
the turn's stop reason and total usage arrive on the result message
parent_tool_use_id is non-null when the message was produced inside a subagent started by that tool_use.

forward_subagent_text_option.description: Forward subagent text and thinking blocks as assistant/user messages with parent_tool_use_id set (only works with --print and --output-format=stream-json)

adapter_projection.behavior: A null message.stop_reason on a parented assistant frame is projected as provider-unspecified activity, not a final answer.
